C_jm_and_log_powers.increment: For each actual Z_j and m define S_(j,m,p)=sup_D q^(ell_m-gj)(|Z_j|_m+|curl A_j+B_j e_theta|_m)/Lambda^p; P=min nonnegative integer with finite S, C=1+ceil S. Lemma9.8 proves the set nonempty on the same domain.
C_jm_and_log_powers.finite_state_and_residual: Let k_m be the least nonnegative integer k such that, for every finite j, some nonnegative integer p makes BOTH sup_D q^k |U[j]|_m/Lambda^p and sup_D q^(k-h*sigma_j)|R(U[j])-Flat[j]|_m/Lambda^p finite. Lemma9.8 makes this set nonempty. Set K_m=max_(r<=m) k_r. For each actual j,m choose the least common p making these two suprema finite and C=1+ceil(max of the suprema). Thus K_m is stage independent and nondecreasing; all actual logarithmic powers and constants are uniquely source defined, not set to zero/one.
